The gateway composes voice as an independent middleware and delegates capability policy to its owning modules. Hidden session visibility, explicit middleware settings and child execution use the framework's shared owners. Anthropic thinking and DeepSeek Flash image-input fixes are included.

Computer control starts the browser only when needed, renews leases for retained page handles and shuts down while waiting for another process to install runtime assets. Voice calls remain bound to the authenticated connection that opened them.

Protocol 93 requires compatible clients. Existing state must be backed up and converted offline with all writers stopped: gateway config 28→29, Bot state 8→9 and checkpoint 19→20. SQLite user versions remain unchanged, so checking only those versions is insufficient. Binary archives include the pinned cloudflared runtime, manuals and licenses.
